items.docs: Returns the list of available generator language identifiers for the given generator type (client, server, documentation, config) and OpenAPI version (V2 or V3).
Returns the list of available generator languages filtered by a comma- separated list of generator types and an optional OpenAPI version.

info.name: Deprecated, use '/{type}/{version}' instead. List generator languages of type 'client' or 'documentation' for given codegen version (defaults to V3)

params.name: version
params.description: generator version used by codegen engine

params.name: clientOnly
params.description: flag to only return languages of type `client`
